incident-bot: PAGE -> billing-metric-variance: prod acct=acct-1234 token_count_delta=+12% (1h) · severity=P2 · https://pager.redwood/incident/1755648901
Maya (oncall): acked, I'm taking triage. bookmarking thread.
Maya (oncall): quick snapshot: emitter->ledger delta ~+12% since 08:10 UTC. EU region consumer shows delayed batches (kafka lag ~18m). Overflagging detected for 2 customers.
Anne (SRE): pinging ingest/producer teams now. any deploys to emitter/aggregator in last 3h?
Maya (oncall): no deploys. spikes look correlated with emitter retry storms. retries up ~3x. logs show repeated 5xx from ledger-write between 08:09-08:12.
Eli (Billing): seeing overage flags for cust-A (trial) and cust-B (payg). Both flagged automatically, invoices may be affected. Holding until we confirm.
Dan (PM): how confident are we this is telemetry/dup and not real extra tokens? need comms plan.
Maya (oncall): initial mitigation proposal: 1) pause emitter retry loop for acct-1234 (feature flag) 2) flip aggregator to strict-dedup/dedup-window 3) run backfill to recompute token counts for last 2h
Anne (SRE): agreed. run these steps with read-only fallback if needed. I'll coordinate the backfill run.
Anne (SRE): commands to run:
```
# pause emitter retry for account
curl -X POST "https://ops.internal/flags/pause?service=emitter&acct=acct-1234"
# set aggregator to dedup mode
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/aggregator AGG_MODE=dedup
# start backfill recompute
python ops/backfill.py --account acct-1234 --from '2026-03-17T07:00Z' --to '2026-03-17T09:30Z' --job-name backfill-1755648901
```
Maya (oncall): executed pause + toggled aggregator. backfill kicked (job id=backfill-1755648901). job status: queued -> running. ETA ~20m.
incident-bot: backfill-1755648901 status=running · logs: https://ops.internal/logs/backfill-1755648901
Eli (Billing): creating temporary credits for cust-A & cust-B (ticket BG-987). Holding invoicing for those accounts until reconciliation complete. Adding note to customer support queue.
Dan (PM): draft customer note ready, short + apologetic. will send only after recon if charges would be wrong.
Anne (SRE): monitoring metrics: emitter retries down, delta fell from +12% -> +4% after toggles. kafka lag now ~3m.
Maya (oncall): backfill progress: 35% (token recompute window 07:00-09:30). No errors so far.
Eli (Billing): will provisionally flag those overage alerts as "suspected false-positive" in billing dashboard to avoid automated escalations.
Maya (oncall): if delta <5% and backfill finishes clean -> mark incident mitigated and start postmortem. If delta persists >7% escalate to SRE lead.
Anne (SRE): agreed. capture replay/ingest traces and include sample IDs for dedup verification.
incident-bot: reminder set: check backfill result in 30m.
Dan (PM): ETA for closure? Maya: aiming to resolve within 30m, will update here.
Maya (oncall): backfill finished, job success. recomputed delta now +1.1% (within noise). kafka lag cleared.
Eli (Billing): confirmed cust-A & cust-B credits applied, alerts cleared. will hold final invoice until tomorrow's reconciled run.
Anne (SRE): closing mitigation. leaving action items: postmortem (tag=billing/token-drift-1755648901), add automated safeties to pause retry after N 5xx, and test dedup-window behavior under retry storms.
Dan (PM): thanks all. preparing short customer-facing note for tomorrow.
Maya (oncall): :white_check_mark: closing incident, will file timeline + logs.
incident-bot: INCIDENT -> status=resolved -> mitigation successful.
